name: Subscriber
description: Learner-owned Stripe subscription details with a server-signed verification cache.

user_id.description: Authenticated Buildy learner account ID bound to the Stripe records.

email.description: Authenticated learner email used for owner-scoped reads.

stripe_customer_id.description: Stripe customer ID verified for this learner.

stripe_subscription_id.description: Stripe subscription ID verified for this learner.

stripe_checkout_session_id.description: Most recent verified Checkout Session ID.

plan.description: Normalized verified offer: premium_monthly or premium_annual.

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether Stripe has scheduled this subscription to cancel at the current period end.

current_period_end.description: Verified Stripe period end as an ISO 8601 date-time.

last_confirmed_at.description: Server verification time used to bound the signed cache.

cache_signature.description: Server-generated HMAC signature for the verified cache fields.
